description: A light grease wiped sparingly on cover and hand so cotton wool will pick up and release gold leaf. Cockerell found it stains leather less than other greases bookbinders use and washes out readily with benzine.
name: cocoanut oil

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter XIV, p.188. Internet Archive.
